title: Control The Weather
body:
Just a simple mod that add 3 Keybinds (Clear, Rain, Thunder) and allows you to choose what type of weather you want.



This was made by MCreator.



The keybinds that change the weather are:



numpad 1 = Rain Storm

numpad 2 = Clear the Weather

numpad 3 = Thunder Storm



The keybinds of course can be changed



This allows players to control when they want it to rain or thunder. For example if its raining you can simply make it clear out or turn it into a thunder storm. This also allows for weather based testing for other mods.
